newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico competition watchdog objects to Servia bid.
newsitem.headline: Mexico competition watchdog objects to Servia bid.

text.p: Mexico's Federal Competition Commission said on Wednesday that it objected to the participation of Grupo Servia in the bidding to obtain the capital of Almacenadora Sur S.A. (Alsur) .
The Commission said in a statement that Servia's bid would create "anti-competitive effects."
Grupo Servia is consortium made up of Transportacion Maritima Mexicana, Louis Dreyfus Corporation, Inversora del Sureste, Vitrocontrol, Moltrim and Societe Generale.
The government commission said it had approved the participation of the groups led by ICA and Grupo Minsa, who will present their offers for Almacenadora Sur on Thursday.
The commission said it objected to the "substantial" power that Grupo Servia would have in the bulk corn market and the control it would have in the imported corn market if the bid went through.
